verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a credentialed filing portal for one-off filings, searches and orders. Its only recurring element is a fixed 'Farm Product Monthly Subscription' and 'Data and Image Subscriptions', which are vendor-defined data deliveries, not user-scheduled recurring jobs or workflows. Nothing documents a scheduler, recurring filings or automated workflow triggers, so this is at most an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
